description:
Multi-timeframe price analysis in plain language for one symbol (quant price action,
    technical signals, timeframe continuity) from your own bars.

    Returns `text` (one short line per timeframe, e.g. "SPY day: 2u, above the day open
    (green). Last 3 bars: 2d 1 2u. In force: bullish 2-1-2 ...") and the same facts as
    JSON: scenario, color, last 3 bars, signals in force, setups, and FTFC (M W D 60).
    Start here, then quote the text to the user. Hosted server: free, no cooldown.
    Fair-use limit: 60 calls per minute.

bars_by_timeframe.description: Bars per timeframe, e.g. {"M": [...], "W": [...], "D": [...], "60": [...]}. Give at least 3 bars per timeframe; more gives more signals.
bars_by_timeframe.title: Bars By Timeframe

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601. Decides if the last bar is still open. Default: the server clock.
now.title: Now

name: describe_price
